messages:
Maya: Heads-up team — PR #4890 (optimize-toolkit) failed docs/link-check; CI shows a couple of legacy slugs and a missing migration snippet for the kv prefetch change. Can someone take link redirects + a tiny SDK snippet we can drop into the migration guide?

/docs-bot: docs/link-checker: 2 broken links found in PR #4890: `/docs/optkit/kv-prefetch` and `/examples/prefetch-legacy.md`. CI job: docs/link-check (failed)

Sam: I can patch the links. Which slugs should they redirect to?

Maya: New locations are `/docs/optimize/prefetch-kv` and `/examples/optkit/prefetch-v2.md`. Also the short notes were folded into `/docs/optimize/prefetch-guidance.md`.

Olivia: Drafting a compact migration snippet for Python and TypeScript — minimal so writers can drop it in: please sanity-check.

Olivia: ```python
# previous usage
result = client.generate(model="redwood-opt-1", inputs=prompt, prefetch=True)

# updated usage
result = client.generate(model="redwood-opt-1", inputs=prompt, config={"kv_prefetch": True})
```

Olivia: ```ts
// previous usage
const result = await client.generate({model: 'redwood-opt-1', inputs: prompt, prefetch: true})

// updated usage
const result = await client.generate({model: 'redwood-opt-1', inputs: prompt, config: {kv_prefetch: true}})
```

Olivia: One-line migration note proposal: "Replace top-level prefetch with config.kv_prefetch to scope prefetch behavior to KV cache semantics and align with other runtime flags."

Lee: Docs voice nit: add a short rationale header above the code: "Why this changed: centralizes runtime flags and clarifies that prefetch targets KV cache behavior." Also add deprecation guidance: "top-level prefetch will continue to be accepted with a deprecation warning for one release." And yes, add a frontmatter redirect on the new page.

Sam: Will add YAML redirects and update the two broken links in the branch. Planning to push a small commit updating the hrefs and adding frontmatter redirects on `/docs/optimize/prefetch-kv` and `/examples/optkit/prefetch-v2.md`.

Maya: Olivia, can you create `docs/snippets/optkit/prefetch-migration.md` in the branch with the two snippets and the one-line migration note? Paste the short rationale into `docs/migration/migration-guide.md` under Optimize Toolkit > Prefetch.

Zach: Happy to do a quick pass after CI is green. Tag me in the PR and Ill review during standup. :thumbsup:

Sam: Pushed link fixes and frontmatter redirects in branch `optkit/migrate-prefetch-4890`. CI queued: docs/link-check.

/docs-bot: docs/link-check queued after Sam's push.

Maya: Thanks all — once docs/link-check is green we can merge. Small follow-up: add a short note in the release notes under breaking changes so customers see the config name change.

Lee: Good call. I'll add a draft line for release notes: "Prefetch config key renamed: `prefetch` -> `config.kv_prefetch` (backwards-compatible for one release, deprecated thereafter)."

Olivia: Snippet file created and pushed in the branch. Leaving a small caption and the rationale as requested.

/docs-bot: PR #4890  docs/link-check running.
